name: a filmstrip of filters pans past one street photo
looks: The same street photo repeats across a horizontal row of narrow panels, each one graded a different way, with a short mono label under each (a cool desaturated look, a warm look, a high-contrast black and white, a punchy saturated look). The camera pans across the row, then a bold two-line title stamps over the top naming the feature.
build: One wide world of absolutely positioned panels, each a copy of the same source image under a different CSS filter/LUT stack; a translateX pan carries the camera across them at a steady rate. The title types in as one block, no per-letter stagger, cutting cleanly over the pan's last third.
sound: A soft continuous whoosh under the pan, a light tick as each panel's label comes into view, a confirming hit under the title.
prompt: Show a set of style presets as one continuous pan across identically framed panels of the same source image, each graded differently and labelled in a small mono tag. Land on a short bold title naming the feature as the pan settles.
